findings.passage: A voter ID requirement is simply a commonsense approach to ensure elections across our state stay secure. It’s a measure supported by Americans and Pennsylvanians.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name after his committee amendment to HB 2473 was not adopted; he says a voter ID requirement is a plain way to keep elections secure and is widely supported. Fetched with curl from the caucus site.

findings.passage: We show identification in every aspect of our lives, from boarding an airplane to applying for government documentation. Confirming one’s identity is an essential part of our lives.
findings.note: Same release: he compares showing ID to vote with showing ID in other parts of daily life.

findings.passage: Enacting voter ID laws is the only way to ensure we get our results right.
findings.note: Same release: closing line tying voter ID laws to the 2024 presidential election results.

findings.motion: Amendment offered in the House State Government Committee to HB 2473
findings.note: Per the release, he offered an amendment to HB 2473 (election procedures and the federal Electoral Count Reform Act) that would have barred the Secretary of the Commonwealth from certifying any election result unless all voters were required to provide a form of identification before voting. The release is dated 2024-07-02; the committee meeting date is not stated.
